# NUICSS (@nofinite/nuicss) - Full AI Context & Superclasses Reference

Semantic CSS utility framework, runtime-less design token engine, and production-ready component superclasses built directly on top of UnoCSS.

## Core Architecture & Engine
- **Engine**: UnoCSS instant atomic CSS compiler.
- **Directives**:
  - `@nuicss;` in CSS expands to preflights, design tokens, shortcuts, and utility rules.
  - `@apply` in stylesheets for inlining atomic classes.
- **Zero Runtime Overhead**: Compiles on-demand at build time or runs via the standalone one-link CDN bundle.
- **Layers**: Resets live in `@layer base`, component superclasses live in `@layer components`, and atomic utilities live in `@layer utilities`.

---

## Theming & Design Tokens

### Semantic Backgrounds
- `bg-page`: Main background canvas (`--bg-page`)
- `bg-canvas`: Viewport / app canvas background (`--bg-canvas`)
- `bg-surface`: Card and container background (`--bg-surface`)
- `bg-surface-raised`: Elevated card background (`--bg-surface-raised`)
- `bg-surface-overlay`: Modal and overlay container background (`--bg-surface-overlay`)
- `bg-subtle`: Subtle secondary surface (`--bg-subtle`)
- `bg-muted`: Muted background fill (`--bg-muted`)
- `bg-accent`: Accent highlight background (`--bg-accent`)
- `bg-card`: Explicit card surface background (`--bg-card`)
- `bg-glass`: Translucent backdrop surface (`--glass-bg`)
- `bg-overlay`: Modal backdrop dimming (`--bg-overlay`)

### Semantic Foreground / Text
- `text-default`: Primary body text (`--fg-default`)
- `text-subtle`: Secondary descriptive text (`--fg-subtle`)
- `text-muted`: Muted labels and placeholder text (`--fg-muted`)
- `text-accent`: Accent text color (`--fg-accent`)
- `text-inverse`: Contrast text on dark/inverted surfaces (`--fg-inverse`)
- `text-disabled`: Disabled text (`--fg-disabled`)
- `text-card`: Card foreground text (`--fg-card`)

### Action & Feedback Colors
- `primary`: Brand primary action color (`--color-primary`, `--color-primary-hover`, `--color-primary-active`, `--color-primary-fg`, `--color-primary-subtle`)
- `secondary`: Secondary action color (`--color-secondary`, `--color-secondary-hover`, `--color-secondary-active`, `--color-secondary-fg`, `--color-secondary-subtle`)
- `danger`: Error and destructive actions (`--color-danger`, `--color-danger-hover`, `--color-danger-fg`, `--color-danger-subtle`)
- `success`: Positive confirmation and status (`--color-success`, `--color-success-hover`, `--color-success-fg`, `--color-success-subtle`)
- `warning`: Cautionary alerts (`--color-warning`, `--color-warning-hover`, `--color-warning-fg`, `--color-warning-subtle`)
- `info`: Informational messages (`--color-info`, `--color-info-hover`, `--color-info-fg`, `--color-info-subtle`)

### Semantic Borders
- `border-default`: Standard container border (`--border-default`)
- `border-subtle`: Low contrast divider border (`--border-subtle`)
- `border-strong`: High contrast card / element border (`--border-strong`)
- `border-hover`: Border hover state (`--border-hover`)
- `border-focus`: Form element focus border (`--border-focus`)
- `border-disabled`: Disabled element border (`--border-disabled`)
- `border-glass`: Glassmorphism translucent border (`--glass-border`)
- Supports directional prefixes: `border-t-default`, `border-b-subtle`, `border-x-strong`, `border-y-default`

### Native Opacity Modifier Support
All semantic background, text, and border utilities support opacity modifiers:
- `bg-surface/80`, `bg-subtle/50`, `bg-primary/20`
- `text-default/90`, `text-subtle/70`
- `border-default/50`, `border-x-strong/60`

---

## Complete Component Superclasses Dictionary

All superclasses support dual naming: concise syntax (e.g. `btn`, `card`) and namespace-isolated syntax (e.g. `nui-btn`, `nui-card`).

### 1. Primitives

#### Button (`btn`)
Interactive button with keyboard navigation rings and micro-scaling.
- Base: `btn` / `nui-btn`
- Variants:
  - `btn-default`: Standard border and surface fill
  - `btn-primary`: Brand primary filled button
  - `btn-secondary`: Neutral slate filled button
  - `btn-outline`: Transparent background with border-strong
  - `btn-ghost`: Borderless button with hover state
  - `btn-danger`: Error / destructive action
  - `btn-link`: Inline text hyperlink style
- Sizes: `btn-sm`, `btn-md`, `btn-lg`, `btn-icon`
- State: `btn-loading` (displays centered animated spinner)

#### Badge (`badge`)
Compact status indicator.
- Base: `badge` / `nui-badge`
- Variants: `badge-default`, `badge-primary`, `badge-success`, `badge-warning`, `badge-danger`, `badge-info`, `badge-subtle`
- Sizes: `badge-sm`, `badge-md`, `badge-lg`
- Modifiers: `badge-pill` (fully rounded), `badge-dot` (bullet dot indicator)

#### Card (`card`)
Content card container with shadow elevation.
- Base: `card` / `nui-card`
- Variants: `card-bordered` (thicker strong border)
- Slots: `card-header`, `card-title`, `card-description`, `card-body`, `card-footer`

#### Avatar (`avatar`)
User profile image or initials wrapper.
- Base: `avatar` / `nui-avatar`
- Sizes: `avatar-sm`, `avatar-md`, `avatar-lg`, `avatar-xl`
- Shapes: `avatar-circle`, `avatar-square`
- Media: `avatar-image`
- Status indicators: `avatar-online`, `avatar-busy`, `avatar-away`
- Group: `avatar-group` (overlapping avatar stack)

#### Divider (`divider`)
Separators for layouts and lists.
- `divider`: Horizontal border divider
- `divider-text`: Horizontal divider with centered label text
- `divider-vertical`: Vertical inline separator bar

#### Kbd (`kbd`)
Keyboard shortcut badge.
- Base: `kbd` / `nui-kbd`
- Sizes: `kbd-sm`, `kbd-md`, `kbd-lg`

#### Skeleton (`skeleton`)
Loading placeholder animation.
- Base: `skeleton` / `nui-skeleton`
- Shapes: `skeleton-text`, `skeleton-circle`, `skeleton-rect`

#### Spinner (`spinner`)
Circular indeterminate loading animation.
- Base: `spinner` / `nui-spinner`
- Sizes: `spinner-sm`, `spinner-md`, `spinner-lg`
- Color: `spinner-primary`

#### Empty State (`empty-state`)
Zero-data placeholder layout.
- Base: `empty-state` / `nui-empty-state`
- Slots: `empty-state-icon`, `empty-state-title`, `empty-state-description`, `empty-state-actions`

#### Stat Card (`stat-card`)
Dashboard KPI / metric display card.
- Base: `stat-card` / `nui-stat-card`
- Slots: `stat-card-label`, `stat-card-value`, `stat-card-trend`
- Trend states: `stat-card-trend-up`, `stat-card-trend-down`

#### Link (`link`)
Hyperlink text styling.
- Base: `link` / `nui-link`
- Modifiers: `link-muted`, `link-hover`

#### Layout Helpers
- `container-center`: Centered max-w-7xl responsive wrapper
- `stack`, `stack-sm`, `stack-lg`: Vertical flex column stacks with gap
- `flex-center`: Centered flexbox layout
- `flex-between`: Space-between flexbox layout

#### Breadcrumbs (`breadcrumbs`)
Navigation path hierarchy.
- Base: `breadcrumbs` / `nui-breadcrumbs`
- Elements: `breadcrumb-list`, `breadcrumb-item`, `breadcrumb-separator`, `breadcrumb-active`, `breadcrumb-current`

#### Timeline (`timeline`)
Chronological activity feed.
- Base: `timeline` / `nui-timeline`
- Elements: `timeline-item`, `timeline-point`, `timeline-time`, `timeline-title`, `timeline-content`

#### Progress (`progress`)
Progress bar indicator.
- Base: `progress` / `nui-progress`
- Sizes: `progress-sm`, `progress-md`, `progress-lg`
- Fill: `progress-bar`
- Variants: `progress-primary`, `progress-success`, `progress-danger`, `progress-indeterminate`

#### Attachment (`attachment`)
File attachment tile with icon and action button.
- Base: `attachment` / `nui-attachment`
- Slots: `attachment-icon`, `attachment-details`, `attachment-name`, `attachment-size`, `attachment-action`

#### Watermark & Provider
- `watermark`, `watermark-pattern`
- `provider`, `nui-provider`, `nuix-provider`

---

### 2. Forms

#### Text Inputs (`input`)
- Base: `input` / `nui-input`
- Sizes: `input-sm`, `input-md`, `input-lg`
- Error: `input-error`
- Addons: `input-group`, `input-addon-left`, `input-addon-right`, `input-has-addon-left`, `input-has-addon-right`

#### Textarea (`textarea`)
- Base: `textarea` / `nui-textarea`
- Error: `textarea-error`

#### Checkbox & Radio
- Checkbox: `checkbox`, `checkbox-sm`, `checkbox-md`, `checkbox-lg`, `checkbox-label`
- Radio: `radio`, `radio-group`, `radio-group-horizontal`, `radio-label`

#### Switch (`switch`)
- Base: `switch` / `nui-switch`
- Slots: `switch-thumb`, `switch-label`

#### Select (`select`)
- Base: `select` / `nui-select`
- Sizes: `select-sm`, `select-lg`

#### Number & Pin Inputs
- Number: `number-input`, `number-input-field`, `number-input-stepper`, `number-input-btn`
- Pin / OTP: `pin-input`, `pin-input-field`, `pin-input-box`

#### Password Input
- `password-input`, `password-toggle-btn`

#### Slider & Rating
- Slider: `slider`
- Rating: `rating`, `rating-star`

#### Segmented Control
- Base: `segmented-control` / `nui-segmented-control`
- Item: `segmented-control-item`

#### Alert (`alert`)
- Base: `alert` / `nui-alert`
- Variants: `alert-success`, `alert-danger`, `alert-warning`, `alert-info`
- Slots: `alert-icon`, `alert-content`, `alert-title`, `alert-description`, `alert-close`

#### Toast (`toast`)
- Container: `toast-container`
- Item: `toast`, `toast-title`, `toast-description`, `toast-close`

#### Form Control Helpers
- Structure: `form-control`
- Labels: `form-label`, `form-label-required`
- Messages: `form-helper-text`, `form-error-message`

#### Rich Text Editor
- Container: `editor`
- Sections: `editor-toolbar`, `editor-content`

### 3. Overlays

#### Modal & Dialog
- Modal: `modal`, `modal-sm`, `modal-md`, `modal-lg`, `modal-xl`, `modal-full`
- Content: `modal-box`, `modal-header`, `modal-title`, `modal-description`, `modal-body`, `modal-footer`, `modal-close`
- Dialog: `dialog`, `dialog-box`, `dialog-icon`, `dialog-icon-danger`, `dialog-icon-warning`, `dialog-icon-info`, `dialog-icon-success`

#### Drawer (`drawer`)
- Base: `drawer` / `nui-drawer`
- Placements: `drawer-right`, `drawer-left`, `drawer-top`, `drawer-bottom`
- Content: `drawer-box`, `drawer-header`, `drawer-title`, `drawer-body`, `drawer-footer`, `drawer-close`

#### Dropdown & Context Menu
- Dropdown: `dropdown`, `dropdown-menu`, `dropdown-item`, `dropdown-item-danger`, `dropdown-divider`, `dropdown-header`
- Context Menu: `context-menu`, `context-menu-item`, `context-menu-divider`, `context-menu-header`

#### Popover & Hover Card
- Popover: `popover-wrapper`, `popover`, `popover-content`, `popover-header`, `popover-body`, `popover-title`, `popover-description`, `popover-close`
- Hover Card: `hover-card`, `hover-card-content`

#### Tooltip (`tooltip`)
- Base: `tooltip` / `nui-tooltip`
- Placements: `tooltip-top`, `tooltip-bottom`, `tooltip-left`, `tooltip-right`
- Arrow: `tooltip-arrow`

#### Command Palette & Link Preview
- Command Palette: `command-palette`, `command-palette-box`, `command-input`, `command-item`
- Link Preview: `link-preview-card`, `link-preview-image-wrapper`, `link-preview-popup`

- Items: `tab`, `tab-pill`
- Content: `tab-panel`

#### Stepper (`stepper`)

- Elements: `step`, `step-indicator`, `step-content`, `step-title`, `step-description`, `step-connector`

#### Pagination (`pagination`)

#### Table (`table`)

#### TreeView (`treeview`)

- Elements: `tree-item`, `tree-node`, `tree-branch`, `tree-toggle`

#### Transfer List (`transfer-list`)

#### Dropzone & File List

#### Resizable & ScrollArea

#### Charts, DataGrid & Kanban

- Kanban: `kanban-board`, `kanban-column`, `kanban-card`

### 5. Media

#### Calendar, DatePicker & TimePicker

- DatePicker: `date-picker`, `date-picker-trigger`, `date-picker-popover`, `date-range-picker`
- TimePicker: `time-picker`, `time-picker-select`, `time-range-picker`

#### Combobox & MultiSelect
- Combobox: `combobox`, `combobox-input`, `combobox-options`, `combobox-option`
- MultiSelect: `multiselect`, `multiselect-tags`, `multiselect-tag`, `multiselect-tag-remove`, `multiselect-input`

#### Carousel & VirtualList
- Carousel: `carousel`, `carousel-viewport`, `carousel-slide`, `carousel-nav`, `carousel-prev`, `carousel-next`, `carousel-dots`, `carousel-dot`
- VirtualList: `virtual-list`, `virtual-list-container`, `virtual-list-item`

#### Code Block (`code-block`)
- Base: `code-block` / `nui-code-block`
- Slots: `code-header`, `code-lang`, `code-copy-btn`, `code-pre`
- Token highlighting: `code-token-keyword`, `code-token-string`, `code-token-comment`, `code-token-number`, `code-token-function`

#### Video Player (`video-player`)
- Elements: `video-player`, `video-controls`, `video-play-btn`, `video-progress`, `video-progress-bar`

#### MegaMenu, Chip & Image
- MegaMenu: `mega-menu`, `mega-menu-trigger`, `mega-menu-content`, `mega-menu-column`, `mega-menu-title`, `mega-menu-link`
- Chip: `chip`, `chip-remove`
- Image: `image-container`, `image-blur`, `image-preview-modal`
